Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players walk out to the middle. Followed by Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Hazratullah Zazai who walk out to open for Afghanistan. Nasum Ahmed to start with the ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Afghanistan bowlers bowled with fire and intensity! They never put a wrong foot forward. All the bowlers were on the money. They never let the batters to score freely and kept picking up wickets in qucik succession. In the middle overs, the bowlers did leak a few extra runs especially Rashid Khan. But in the death overs the pacers enjoyed their time with the ball and did not let the Bangladesh tail-enders to take the game away from them. Fazalhaq Farooqi and Azmatullah Omarzai were the pick of the bowlers with three wickets each. The onus is now on their batters to chase down the target and level the series. An enticing chase coming your way. Do join us in a short while.

Bangladesh batters could not justify their skipper's decision to bat first. The hosts lost two wickets inside the Powerplay. Liton Das could not repeat the heroics of the last game and was sent back cheaply. It was a stand between Mahmudullah and Mushfiqur Rahim that resurrected their innings. Bangladesh could only rack up 23 runs in the final five overs and kept losing wickets in cluster to end on a below-par score.

What a dominating performance by Afghanistan with the ball. They never let the Bangladesh batters settle down and have restricted them to a low total of 115 runs. This is what Mohammad Nabi wanted from his men and they have delivered brilliantly when it matters the most. Afghanistan will surely be the happier side going into the break. But the job is only half done by now and it is on their batters to step up now.

A length ball, outside off. Mustafizur Rahman stands tall and punches it to sweeper cover. Darwish Rasooli makes a sharp stop in the deep and the batters take three. Bangladesh end their innings with 115/9.
LEG BYE! Fuller, on the pads. Ahmed thinks it will be a short ball and ducks prematurely. The ball rolls off the pads and they collect a leg bye.
Full length, wide outside off. Nasum Ahmed tries to chase it away but misses.
A short ball, outside off. Nasum Ahmed has a wild swing at it but misses.
Fuller on off. Mustafizur Rahman pushes it to mid off for another single.
Janat fires in a yorker, on the stumps. Nasum Ahmed drives it through point for a single.

Fazalhaq Farooqi give nothing away in the penultimate over. A wicket and just 4 runs off it. He ends his spells of 4 overs with a slower delivery. Mustafizur Rahman fails to pick it away and gets beaten, only to see the ball scoot past the off pole.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Nasum Ahmed drills it to long on for a single.
Full-length ball, wide outside off. Mustafizur Rahman works it towards third man for a single.
Full length, outside off. Nasum Ahmed chips it towards mid off. They get one.
A sharp bouncer, on middle and leg. Mustafizur Rahman gets it to fine leg. They take one.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in.

OUT! CLEANED UP! Fazalhaq Farooqi picks up his third wicket and he has shut the crowd here. It is pin-drop silence here in Mirpur now. Fazalhaq Farooqi fires in a yorker, right on the money. Shohidul Islam stays inside the crease and fails to dig it out. The ball goes through to rattle the stumps.
LEG BYE! Full length, on the pads. Shoriful Islam tries to flick it away but misses. The ball rolls out off his pads and they cross for a leg bye.
Full length, outside off. Shoriful Islam tries to chase it but misses.

OUT! CAUGHT! Azmatullah Omarzai picks up his third wicket and he is having a really good day with the ball. A full toss, on off. Afif Hossain gets inside the line, bends his knees and lines up for a scoop shot. He goes through with the shot but does not get the desired elevation. Hazratullah Zazai moves to his left at short fine leg and completes the catch. Afif Hossain departs without troubling the score much. Shoriful Islam is the new man in.
Commentary.Howout: c Hazratullah Zazai b Azmatullah Omarzai

Commentary.Commentary: Good length, on middle and leg. Nasum Ahmed makes room and whips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, wide outside off. Afif Hossain drives it through covers for a single.
Full length, on off. Afif Hossain digs it out to mid off.
A length ball, on the pads. Afif Hossain flicks it to deep square leg for one. A brilliant over by Fazalhaq Farooqi comes to an end.
A full toss, outside off. Nasum Ahmed slices it towards deep point for a single.
Play and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Nasum Ahmed tries to chase it away but misses.
Nasum Ahmed is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! What a ripper. Fazalhaq Farooqi is on fire and he now sends back Mahedi Hasan on a golden duck. Fazalhaq Farooqi serves a yorker, right in the blockhole with much pace on it. Mahedi Hasan gets beaten by the pace itself as he was late to get his blade down in time. The ball goes through to hit the off stump hard. Fazalhaq Farooqi is elated.

LEG BYE! Full length, angling down leg. Afif Hossain fails to flick and gets hit on the pads. Fazalhaq Farooqi makes a polite enquiry but the umpire is unmoved. The batters take a leg bye and 100 up for Bangladesh.
Mahedi Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fazalhaq Farooqi comes back into the attack and sends back Mushfiqur Rahim. A full-length ball, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim tries to clear the infield on the off side but fails to get the desired elevation on it. The ball lobs towards covers. Mohammad Nabi runs to his left and pouches it comfortably. It was a slower delivery and Mushfiqur Rahim was undone by it.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nabi b Fazalhaq Farooqi

Commentary.Commentary: Full length, on off. Afif Hossain steers it towards backward point.
A low full toss, on off. Mushfiqur Rahim tries to put it away but ends up chipping it towards mid-wicket. They take one.
FOUR! Nicely played. Full length, on the pads. Mushfiqur Rahim stays back and flicks it with great timing to beat the man at deep square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length, on off. Afif Hossain guides it down to third man for one.
Short ball, on the stumps. Mushfiqur Rahim makes room and cuts it through point for a single.
A length ball, on off. Mushfiqur Rahim works it to mid off.
FOUR! A glorious drive to get off the mark. It is full and outside off. Afif Hossain leans in and drives it through covers for a boundary. 10 runs and a wicket off it.
On off, blocked out.
Afif Hossain is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Rashid Khan strikes and he has the last laugh. Rashid Khan knew he had his man and he did not even turn back to have a look at the umpire. This is the confidence he has on his deliveries. It is tossed up, around middle and off. It holds it's line. Mahmudullah gets on one knee and tries to sweep it away but misses it completely. He gets pinged on his pads and it is plumb as well. Mahmudullah has a word with Mushfiqur Rahim and decides to walk back to the dugout.
Around leg. Rahim glances it to fine leg for a single.
Full and on leg. Mahmudullah flicks it to short fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Mahmudullah is taking the attack to Rashid Khan. Floated, full and angled down leg. Mahmudullah gets low and sweeps it to fine leg for a boundary. Mahmudullah also racks up 2000 runs in T20Is for Bangladesh.
Back of a length, outside off. Mahmudullah rides the bounce and cuts it to deep point for another single. This stand is building really well for the hosts.
Full length, on off. Rahim pushes it to cover for one.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! A short ball, outside off. Rahim stands tall and cuts it crisply through point for a boundary.

FOUR! Cheeky! A full-length ball, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim gets inside the line and  goes for the scoop shot. He does not middle it but gets enough to clear the effort of Rahmanullah Gurbaz behind the stumps. The ball races away to the boundary.
A length ball, outside off. Rahim steers it to third man. The batters take two as the fielder fumbles.
BEATEN! Good-length ball, on off. Some extra bounce off the deck. Mushfiqur Rahim makes room and tries to cut it away but misses.

Touch short, on middle and leg. Mahmudullah stays back and looks to cut it away to the off side but misses. He gets pinged on his pads. Sharafuddin Ashraf makes a huge appeal but the umpire is unmoved.
WIDE! Floated, full and angled down leg. Mahmudullah tries to sweep but misses. Wide called.
BEATEN! Looped up, full, outside off. Mahmudullah looks to defend inside the line and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Short and on middle, Rahim stays back and tucks it to mid-wicket for an easy single.
Back of a length, outside off. Mahmudullah shuffles across and works it to long on for one.
Short and on off. Offering not much room. Mushfiqur Rahim flicks it to the leg side for one.
FOUR! What a shot! Mushfiqur Rahim finding his feet! Tossed up, full and outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim reaches out and lofts it over the cover region for a boundary.
Fuller, on the pads. Mahmudullah tucks it to mid-wicket with soft hands and the batters run two sharply.
FOUR! Mahmudullah has come out with a plan. Length, on middle and leg. Mahmudullah ges on one knee and sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full and on leg. Mahmudullah tucks it to mid-wicket and gets across for a quick single. There is on overthrow and the batters take another single.
FOUR! A much needed boundary. Tossed up, fuller, on middle and leg. Mahmudullah gets low and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket. He disects the fielders in the deep and bags a boundary.
Full and on off. Mushfiqur Rahim dabs it towards third man and scampers across for a quick single.
Floated, full and on off. Mushfiqur Rahim reverse-sweeps it uppishly towards short third man. It meets the fielder on a bounce though.
Full and on off. Rahim gets it long off for one.
Short and on off, it flies off the deck as well. Mushfiqur Rahim is taken back by surprise and he leaves it alone in the end.
Fuller, on off. Mushfiqur Rahim drives it into covers.

NOT OUT! Afghanistan lose a review and Mushfiqur Rahim stays in the middle. Floated, full and around off. Mushfiqur Rahim shuffles across and tries to hit it away but misses. Het gets pinged on his pads. Sharafuddin Ashraf appeals but the umpire is unmoved. Sharafuddin Ashraf convines his skipper to take it upstairs. But it shows the ball is missing the wickets.

Review! Mohammad Nabi takes the review for lbw. The original decision is not out. No bat confirms the UltraEdge. The Ball Tracking shows impact is umpire's call although the ball is missing the wickets. Afghanistan lose a review.
Fuller, on off. Mahmudullah pushes it to cover for one.
Flighted, around off. It flies off the deck. Mahmudullah plays it late but is unable to clear the man at short third man.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Mahmudullah clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Full length, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim works it to third man for a single.
A length ball, outside off. Rahim leaves it alone for the keeper.

DRINKS! Bangladesh are in all sort of trouble at the moment. They need Mahmudullah and Mushfiqur Rahim to do the repair work and get a competitive total on the board. Afghanistan bowlers are running riots at the moment and they seem to be eyeing a revenge for the last game. Can Afghanistan restrict Bangladesh below 100 runs?

OUT! CAUGHT! The crowd has gone silent as Azmatullah Omarzai punches in air. He gets his second wicket in his second over and Shakib Al Hasan holes out this time. Back of a length, on off. Shakib Al Hasan stays inside the crease and tries to pull it away. He gets the top-edge and the ball flies high in the air. It goes toward short third man. Rahmanullah Gurbaz the man with the gloves calls for the catch and takes it comfortably.
Commentary.Howout: c Rahmanullah Gurbaz b Azmatullah Omarzai

Commentary.Commentary: A full-length ball, on off. Shakib Al Hasan looks to hard on this one and only manages to get an inside edge. The ball rolls past the stumps and Mushfiqur Rahim was quick to call for a single. There is an overthrow and the batters take one more.
A short ball, on the body. Mushfiqur Rahim flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, on the pads, Rahim clips it through mid-wicket for a single. Another brilliant over by Khan.
Short and on off. Shakib Al Hasan pulls it to wide of long on and they take a single.
Fuller, on off, blocked out.
A short ball, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim cuts it to deep point for a single. He gets off the mark.
Fuller, on off. Shakib Al Hasan defends it to mid off and gets a single.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks out to bat now in his 100th T20I game.

OUT! RUN OUT! Karim Janat you beauty! He showed good presence of mind, as all the players had their focus on the lbw shout made by the bowler and the keeper. It is tossed up, around leg. Mohammad Naim tries to heave it across the line, but gets an inside edge and works it towards square leg. Naim was ball watching while Shakib Al Hasan was charging towards the other end for a single. Naim was late to react and Janat made sure to make the most of it by scoring a direct hit at the non-striker's end and sends back Mohammad Naim.
Is that a run out? The replays confirm Mohammad Naim was way short of the crease and the big screen shows OUT.
Floated, full and on off. Shakib Al Hasan pushes it to the right of the bowler. Nabi dives to that side and makes a solid stop. Three dots in a row to end the over.
On off, pushed to covers.
Fuller, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan gets low and cuts it towards point. Not in the gap though.
Fuller, on off. Naim works it through third man for a single.
Short and outside off. Naim works it to the off side.
On off, pushed to cover for one.

NOT OUT! Rashid Khan believed he had his man and so the umpire. Although, the third umpire had other ideas. Mohammad Naim wisely takes the review and keeps himself in the middle. Floated, full and on middle andleg. Naim looks to flick it away but gets beaten to get hit on the pads. It looked plumb to the naked eye and teh umpire raised his finger as soon as Khan appealed. The review was taken and it confirmed the ball was pitching outside leg.

Review! Mohammad Naim takes the review for lbw! The on-field decision is OUT. The UltraEdge confirms no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking later shows the ball is pitching outside leg and the crowd errupts to sow their support for the hosts.
A googly, quicker through the air. Tad outside off. Naim stays on the back foot and tries to cut it away but misses.
Flighted and full, on middle and leg. Shakib Al Hasan eases it towards mid on for one.
On leg, Naim clips it to the leg side for one.
Quicker and flatter, on the stumps. Mohammad Naim gets it on the deck off the inside edge.
Flaoted, on the pads. Shakib Al Hasan flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Rashid Khan comes into the attack now.
Fuller, on off. Shakib Al Hasan drives it into covers for a single. Bangladesh are 33/2 at the end of Powerplay.
On a length, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan slashes it towards backward point.
Floated, full and on leg. Naim clips it to the leg side for a single.
On off, blocked out to safety.
On the pads, Shakib Al Hasan flicks it through square leg for a single.
Fuller, on off. Shakib Al Hasan defends it to cover.
FOUR! Up and over! Mohammad Naim getting into the act now. Full length, on off. Mohammad Naim gets under it and lofts it over mid on for a boundary.
Length and on off, blocked out.
A full-length delivery, on off. Naim drives it towards mid on but straight to the fielder.
BEATEN! A length ball, outside off. Naim looks to chase it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! What a shot! A short ball, outside off. Naim stands tall and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Shakib Al Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Azmatullah Omarzai strikes on his very first delivery and gets rid of a dangerous man in Liton Das. Back of a length, on middle and leg. Liton Das stays back and pulls it to deep square leg. He does not middle it though. Sharafuddin Ashraf takes a sharp catch in the deep as he rolls on the floor after pouching it. Bangladesh seem to be in some trouble now.
Commentary.Howout: c Sharafuddin Ashraf b Azmatullah Omarzai

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, on the pads, Naim flicks it to the leg side but straight to the fielder.
Full, on off, Das works it through mid on for one.
Quicker, fuller, on the pads. Liton Das flicks it past mid on although he does not hit it cleanly and Darwish Rasooli cuts it out in the deep for a couple.
Floated, around off, Naim guides it towards backward point for a single.
Fuller, on off. Naim drives it hard into the off side. Rashid Khan does well at short cover to save a single.
Full, on off. Naim pushes it softly to cover.
Full length, outside off. Mohammad Naim comes down the track and punches it to cover. They take a single. Mohammad Naim is off the mark now.
A length ball, on off. Das pushes it out with soft hands and scampers across for a quick single.

SIX! BANG! Liton Das keeps a cool head and Fazalhaq Farooqi can just watch the ball sail into the stands. A short ball now, on off. Liton Das swivels on the back foot and smokes it over the square leg fence.
A length ball, on the pads. Liton Das flicks it through square leg for a brace.

WHAT A BEAUTY! Some heat building between the players now. Fazalhaq Farooqi serves a back-of-a-length delivery, outside off. shaping away. Liton Das tries to chase it but misses. He gets beaten on the outside edge. Fazalhaq Farooqi likes it very much and lets the batter know about the same. Das isn't happy and he walks down the track and the two share some words.
Good length, on the pads. Das shuffles inside the line and defends it to the left of the bowler.
Flatter, on off. Das punches it to mid off for a quick single. He gets off the mark.
Full and on off, blocked back to the bowler.
Liton Das is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mohammad Nabi draws the first blood here. Munim Shahriar always tried to attack and this wicket was always on the cards. It is tossed up, outside off. Munim Shahriar comes down the track and tries to clear the man at mid off but he was a tad early into his shot. The ball lobs towards mid off and Sharafuddin Ashraf takes the simplest of catches. Bangladesh lose an early wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Sharafuddin Ashraf b Mohammad Nabi

Commentary.Commentary: Looped up, outside off. Munim Shahriar looks to chase it but gets beaten.
FOUR! Top Shot! Fuller, on off. Munim Shahriar frees his arms and drives it down the ground past mid off to bag a boundary.
Flighted, just outside off. It flies off the deck. Munim Shahriar tries to chase it but misses. He gets beaten on the outside edge.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Mohammad Nabi to share the new ball.

BYE! On a length, outside off, shaping away sharply. Munim Shahriar is unable to reach it. Rahmanullah Gurbaz dives to his right and gets a hand to it. The ball goes past the slip fielder and the batters sneak a bye.

A full-length ball, on middle and leg. Munim Shahriar comes down the track and tries to flick it to the leg side. He gets a leading edge to covers. No danger though. A great comeback by Fazalhaq Farooqi after starting with two looseners.
BEATEN! A length ball, outside off, shaping away from the right-hander. Munim Shahriar tries to chase it but misses.
Three dots on the trot! This time Fazalhaq Farooqi fires in a yorker, right in the blockhole. Munim Shahriar gets his blade down quickly and pushes it back to the bowler.
A full-length ball, on middle and leg. Munim Shahriar makes room and tries to pummel it downtown. He only manges to get an inside edge on the pads. Fazalhaq Farooqi has found his rhythm.
Much better from Fazalhaq Farooqi. A length ball, on off. Munim Shahriar stays inside the crease and blocks it out safely.

WIDE! This is really poor. Second wide on the trot. A length ball, angling down leg. Munim Shahriar looks to chase it but misses. Rahmanullah Gurbaz yet again jumps to his left to make a brilliant stop. Wide called by the umpire.

WIDE! Fazalhaq Farooqi starts with a loosener. Back of a length, down leg. Munim Shahriar looks to flick it away but misses. It was moving away sharply. Rahmanullah Gurbaz flies to his left behind the stumps to complete the take. Fazalhaq Farooqi takes no time to appreciate his effort.

We are set for the action. The Afghanistan players stride out to the middle. Followed by Munim Shahriar and Mohammad Naim who walk out to open for Bangladesh. Fazalhaq Farooqi to start with the new ball.
All the players are out on the field. They observes a minute silence to pay their respects to Shane Warna and Rodney Marsh. A huge loss to Australia Cricket and the cricketing world as a whole.

Mahmudullah, the skipper of Bangladesh, is in for a chat. He says, they will like to bat first again. He thinks the pitch is hard enough to bat first. Ends by saying they have a single change. Mohammad Nabi joins the chat. He says, they would’ve liked to bat first as well. But mentions they will now aim to restrict them to a low target. Adds he hopes the players don’t repeat the same mistake. Ends by saying they have two changes to the side.

PITCH REPORT - It is bright and sunny with a bit of a breeze. There is grass on the surface which is nicely spread out and that’s the reason why is has turned into a sporting pitch. Both the batters and bowlers will enjoy their time out in the middle.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Hazratullah Zazai, Usman Ghani (In for Mujeeb Ur Rahman), Darwish Rasooli, Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi (C), Karim Janat, Rashid Khan, Azmatullah Omarzai, Fazalhaq Farooqi, Sharafuddin Ashraf (In for Qais Ahmad).

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Liton Das (WK), Mohammad Naim, Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Munim Shahriar, Mahedi Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (In for Yasir Ali), Nasum Ahmed, Shoriful Islam, Mustafizur Rahman.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Bangladesh. They have opted to BAT first.

Afghanistan though are a formidable side in the shortest format of the game. Their spinning trio of Khan, Mujeeb and Naib always keeps them in the game. Although, their young batters are struggling to find their feet and would hope they do so in the last T20I match of the series. A win here will certainly help with their confidence. Will Afghanistan be able to level the series? We shall find out soon, as the toss is not far away.

Bangladesh batters need to step up in this game, as it was a lone battle fought by Das that made sure to take the hosts to defendable total in the last game. Later, Nasum Ahmed worked his magic and helped his side over the line. Bangladesh would hope their players are able to turn the game on its head whenever required. With the T20 World Cup, 2022 around the corner the hosts would hope to get their campaign back on track with a clean sweep.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second T20I game between Bangladesh and Afghanistan. After winning the ODI series, Bangladesh would also want to add this trophy to their cabinet. Although, Afghanistan won’t make it easy. Also, the atmosphere surrounding the cricketing world is at it's all time low after the game lost a greatest player of all time in Shane Warne. We offer our deepest condolences to his family and friends. The legend will always be remembered. We hope some good cricket should help us get our minds off it.
... MATCH DAY ...
